G.definition: cell_volume * sum(entropy_variables(U_stage) * actual finite_volume_rhs(U_stage)); actual FV RHS contraction, not minus an assumed observer rate.
G.time_rule: Original t_stage_or_step_time = containing accepted step time_n for all three stages; not a physical SSP-RK3 stage-state timestamp.
G.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

D_bg.definition: Independent observer background production rate: dy*sum(pi_bg on unique periodic +x faces) + dx*sum(pi_bg on unique periodic +y faces).
D_bg.time_rule: Original t_stage_or_step_time = containing accepted step time_n for all three stages; not a physical SSP-RK3 stage-state timestamp.
D_bg.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

D_aa.definition: Independent observer acoustic production rate: dy*sum(pi_aa on unique periodic +x faces) + dx*sum(pi_aa on unique periodic +y faces).
D_aa.time_rule: Original t_stage_or_step_time = containing accepted step time_n for all three stages; not a physical SSP-RK3 stage-state timestamp.
D_aa.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

D_at.definition: Independent observer tangential production rate: dy*sum(pi_at on unique periodic +x faces) + dx*sum(pi_at on unique periodic +y faces).
D_at.time_rule: Original t_stage_or_step_time = containing accepted step time_n for all three stages; not a physical SSP-RK3 stage-state timestamp.
D_at.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

D_total.definition: Observer independent total quadratic production form, integrated over unique periodic faces; not replaced by the sum of channel rates.
D_total.time_rule: Original t_stage_or_step_time = containing accepted step time_n for all three stages; not a physical SSP-RK3 stage-state timestamp.
D_total.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

S_n.definition: S(U_n) = cell_volume*sum(-rho*(log(p)-gamma*log(rho))/(gamma-1)), gamma=1.4; single actual state mathematical entropy.
S_n.time_rule: Value refers to time_n, the start of the accepted-step interval; preserve that alongside endpoint series convention.
S_n.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

S_np1.definition: Same S(U) definition evaluated on the actual accepted updated state U_np1.
S_np1.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

DeltaS.definition: S_np1 - S_n; actual entropy change of one accepted step, not total DeltaS(T).
DeltaS.time_rule: Accepted-step interval [time_n,time_np1]; endpoint convention time_np1 unless field specifies time_n.
DeltaS.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

E_bg_step.definition: dt*(D_bg_stage1/6 + D_bg_stage2/6 + 2*D_bg_stage3/3); SSP-RK3 stage-weighted observer increment.
E_bg_step.time_rule: Accepted-step interval [time_n,time_np1]; endpoint convention time_np1 unless field specifies time_n.
E_bg_step.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

E_aa_step.definition: dt*(D_aa_stage1/6 + D_aa_stage2/6 + 2*D_aa_stage3/3); SSP-RK3 stage-weighted observer increment.
E_aa_step.time_rule: Accepted-step interval [time_n,time_np1]; endpoint convention time_np1 unless field specifies time_n.
E_aa_step.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

E_at_step.definition: dt*(D_at_stage1/6 + D_at_stage2/6 + 2*D_at_stage3/3); SSP-RK3 stage-weighted observer increment.
E_at_step.time_rule: Accepted-step interval [time_n,time_np1]; endpoint convention time_np1 unless field specifies time_n.
E_at_step.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

E_obs_step.definition: E_bg_step + E_aa_step + E_at_step; channel-attributed total observer increment.
E_obs_step.time_rule: Accepted-step interval [time_n,time_np1]; endpoint convention time_np1 unless field specifies time_n.
E_obs_step.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

E_total_independent_step.definition: dt*(D_total_stage1/6 + D_total_stage2/6 + 2*D_total_stage3/3); independently weighted total quadratic form.
E_total_independent_step.time_rule: Accepted-step interval [time_n,time_np1]; endpoint convention time_np1 unless field specifies time_n.
E_total_independent_step.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

R_time_step.definition: DeltaS + E_obs_step; residual of this accepted step.
R_time_step.time_rule: Accepted-step interval [time_n,time_np1]; endpoint convention time_np1 unless field specifies time_n.
R_time_step.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

R_time_cumulative.definition: S_np1 - S0 + sum_channels(sum_accepted_steps_to_current(E_channel_step)); the logger accumulates channels separately then sums them. Retain the recorded value, do not substitute a cumulative sum of R_time_step with different rounding.
R_time_cumulative.time_rule: Recorded current endpoint time_np1; accumulation from t=0 through that endpoint.
R_time_cumulative.scope: Canonical periodic Case7, first-order FV, 128x128; unique +x/+y faces including each periodic seam once.

time_index_conventions.source_step_index: 1-based completed accepted steps, 1..N, no initial CSV row; stage rows refer to the containing accepted step.
time_index_conventions.canonical_step_index: source_step_index unchanged, 1..N; do not apply the Case8 source+1 mapping.
time_index_conventions.point_index: Canonical 0-based row ordinal within its history: stage row 3*(step-1)+(source_stage-1), step row step-1.

stage_physical_time.meaning: Recorded containing step start time_n, common to all three stage rows. Preserve original value and explain clock semantics.

time_index_conventions.stage_interval_context: May reference the associated recorded step interval by step index; no spatial/time interpolation.

snapshot_index.reason: No saved spatial trajectory or snapshot stream.

cumulative_field_inventory.policy: These cumulative channel histories are not recorded columns. Preserve E_*_step as increments. A future history can only be an explicitly validated adapter derivation from accepted-step increments, with original values, order, source hashes and terminal agreement; no frontend scientific accumulation.
cumulative_field_inventory.rounding_policy: Frozen logger accumulates each channel separately; preserve that accumulation order when verifying terminal totals. E_total_independent_step is separate from E_obs_step.

refinement.frozen_global_definition: Existing frozen least-squares log-log slope of abs(R(T)) versus dt_eff; value read from frozen_audit_summary.json, not refitted in Phase9.
refinement.future_adapter_slope_policy: Bind existing frozen pairwise/global slopes to their source hashes and run set. Any different derivation must be explicitly labeled VERIFIED_DERIVATION, with inputs, formula, processing identity and checks; translate to DERIVED_VERIFIED for the frozen schema VerificationStatus. Never replace frozen summary.

refinement.run_scope: D_u four stored CFL values only

flow.reason: Closure production outputs contain stage/step scalar CSV and run summaries; no spatial state trajectory is saved.

allocation.reason: No saved spatial map or trajectory.

scientific_claim_boundary.supported: Actual FV RHS entropy contraction and independent observer production achieve measured floating-point semi-discrete closure in the frozen periodic first-order Case7 protocol.
scientific_claim_boundary.fully_discrete: R_time_step and R_time_cumulative measure temporal residuals; they are not exact identities. Existing D_u temporal refinement approaches actual discrete state entropy change with observed slope near 3.
scientific_claim_boundary.state_entropy: DeltaS is one actual state entropy change; E_bg/E_aa/E_at attribute interface production and are not separate state entropies.
forbidden_claims: SSP-RK3 establishes a new fully-discrete entropy theorem.
All time integrators have the same property.
Closure applies to all boundary conditions.
Universal entropy stability or physical-performance claims.

implementation_boundary.allowed_next_scope: Implement a source-bound Closure adapter against this audited map after Window0 ends; later API/UI slices must use frozen schema and IA.
adapter_requirements: Explicit five-run registry; verify source hashes and immutable run identity before reading.
PER_STAGE and PER_STEP histories remain distinct.
Preserve every source index/clock and map source stages 1/2/3 to canonical 0/1/2.
Do not rename E_*_step to cumulative or combine temporal residual types.
B_u recorded zeros remain KNOWN,value:0; missing fields/assets remain MISSING with no zero-fill.
Bind refinement slopes to frozen assets or label VERIFIED_DERIVATION with full processing verification.
Source/code drift and raw-data drift are separate provenance conditions.
Flow remains MISSING with trajectory replay UNSUPPORTED, hidden Flow tab and explanatory deep-link handling.

verification.method: All raw stage and step CSV rows read, fields checked and formulas recomputed; terminal outputs bound to hash-verified frozen assets.

source_preservation.scope: All files under closure root, including logs and __pycache__, plus every frozen-config/imported-solver identity file; other scientific-root files were not written.
source_preservation.read_only_method: Python stdlib read-only CSV/JSON/hash inspection; scientific scripts not imported or executed; python -B.

limitations: Evidence is limited to five frozen periodic Case7 first-order FV runs with SSP-RK3, T=10, 128x128.
No spatial state trajectory, no spatial stage data and no substitute fields from other experiments/runs.
Stage clock is a containing-step start label, not an independently recorded physical stage-state time.
Only R_time_cumulative is a recorded step-history cumulative column; channel cumulative values are frozen terminal totals.
Model units have no established SI mapping.
Adapter/API/UI delivery remains PLANNED; scientific source availability is not software implementation status.
Preflight/profiling runs in logs are excluded from scientific production registry.
Hash preservation check covers the complete Closure tree and identified imported solver sources; it is not a whole-scientific-root inventory.
